why: The national data governance strategy is the instrument that states the localisation rule itself - a copy of data generated in Cote d'Ivoire held in the Cloud national or Datacenter National, critical data classed as sovereignty-relevant - and the report's ledger holds news of it but not the document.

The only in-window movement on the localisation policy's own vehicle: the ministry's dated site visit putting the Data Center National above 20 per cent execution at FCFA 42.361bn. The brief found no new decree or regulator decision imposing localisation in the window.

The portal's own founding statement of the policy, naming the CICG as pilot, dating the initiative to 2014 and citing loi n 2013-867 as its legal basis - the closest thing to an enacting instrument, since both briefs established that no standalone Ivorian open-data act exists.

A dated regulator publication with a stated national position: nine licensed payment institutions in Cote d'Ivoire out of thirty-one in the Union under Instruction n 001-01-2024. Baseline is nil because that instruction is already held in the base under XWA.

A distinct national event: the Council of Ministers adopting a banking-regulation bill that expressly brings FinTech firms and electronic-money operations into the national perimeter, which the communique says the current law does not cover.

The enacting statute itself: chapter V mandates the referentiel general d'interoperabilite and a state interoperability platform all administrative authorities must connect to, and articles 25-26 bar re-demanding data already produced. Statute beats the 2024 amending ordinance and the news of it.
A completed step, not an intention: the ministry's own record of the launch of the platform article 20 of the ordinance requires, naming UXP, the SNDI and twelve pilot structures.

A distinct later event: the state's reference identity, the NNI on the RNPP, put to work across institutions to request and track civil-status documents, the criminal record and residence certificates.

Names the governing statute - loi n 2020-950 modifying loi n 2013-537 - and records its three implementing decrees on the statistical visa, pricing and administrative-file transfers. Taken as baseline only because the statute's own text on ins.ci could not be fetched by either client.
The opening dated step of the framework's revision: consensus adoption of the diagnostic report on the national statistical system as the basis for the SNDS 2026-2030.

The closing dated step of the same reform and a distinct event: technical validation of the consolidated SNDS 2026-2030 on 30 April 2026, described by the ministry as the last stage before official adoption. Repointed at a sibling slice's baseline file for the same URL - baseline wins.

The standard's move into implementation: the referentiel general d'interoperabilite adopted by decret 2021-913 is already held in the base, so the movement, not the instrument, is what this indicator can gain.

A distinct later event with stated positions: five administrations connected, a target of 100 interoperable services by end-2026 out of 31 judged mature, and the SNDI director general stating the platform itself is already available.

The most recent authoritative publication of the national price series, and the one that defines its own terms: prix moyens constates from real consumption, 0.33 FCFA per megabyte for mobile data at Q1 2025 against 0.80 in 2020. No in-window regulator decision or new measurement survived, so no progress item is staged.

The only document that states an off-site resilience capacity for the state estate: the ministry's launch statement giving the Data Center National's declared specification and its disaster-recovery and business-continuity purpose.
A completed step inside the window: a second Tier III facility commissioned at the VITIB and presented by the ministry as hosting administrations' and firms' strategic data.

A distinct event two months later on the state's own facility, with a stated position: above 20 per cent execution and FCFA 42.361bn of financing. One file, also selected by gov.policy--data-localisation-policies.

The standing published series: temps moyen de coupure from 44h38 min in 2015 to 17h54 min in 2021 and back up to 26h13 mn in 2024, with system yield at 83.7 per cent. Ivorian primary sources publish TMC rather than SAIDI or SAIFI.

The government's own dated position on the 2026 outage episode - transmission and distribution loading, not a generation shortfall - with load-shedding described as temporary. Only one progress item is staged because the emergency-programme announcement exists solely as an undated flash line.

The most recent authoritative publication of the coverage series: 8,690 localities electrified at end-2024, coverage 94.3 per cent on the RGPH 2014 base, access 98.6 per cent, with PRONER and PEPT outturns. One file, also selected by infra.energy--grid-reliability.
A dated financing decision with stated quantities: 103.14m euros approved on 15 May 2026 for 244 rural localities and over 107,000 household connections, plus the PROSER I outturn.

A distinct event and the government's own measurement: 684,735 new household connections in 2025, with four of ten priority reform actions reported delayed - a movement figure and a named obstacle in one primary document.

The state's own statement of an in-house ICT directorate's mandate and structure under decret n 2018-38 - running the SIGFAE, development, network, operations, audit and authorisations. The 2021 decree instituting a DSI in every ministry is already held in the base.

A completed legal step carrying a capacity component: ratification of the 128.6m euro IDA loan for PADCI phase 1, whose stated objects include making the digital agencies and AI governance frameworks operational and developing advanced and intermediate digital skills. Repointed at a sibling slice's file for the same URL.

The only in-window event found that is about education systems exchanging data rather than about the national platform generally: GIS data to be integrated into the existing SIGE for the carte scolaire, ministerially directed 19 August 2026. Secondary source, stated in the note; no MENA publication of the meeting was located. No baseline staged, since the authoritative baseline, the SNDECI 2024-2028, is already held in raw.

The Treasury's own account of the platform through which the state collects and pays electronically, citing the decree of 6 November 2019 that instituted electronic collection for communes, regions and districts. Chosen over the BCEAO regional instruments because the indicator asks what Cote d'Ivoire itself operates. Undated page; year precision from its copyright line.

A completed, dated extension of the state payment rail into public health establishments by the DGTCP itself, with the USSD syntax published, the clearest business-to-government or citizen-to-government payment step in the window from an Ivorian primary source.

The dated standing position of the interoperable instant payment platform that Ivorian banks and e-money issuers connect to: 80 participants at 2 April 2026 and a 30 June 2026 connection deadline. Distinct event from the Treasury deployment. Regional scope declared in the note; the 30 September 2025 launch list is already held in raw.

The register's own operator describing the RCCM, the decree that made the Tribunal de Commerce the national file, the obligation to transmit local files in digital form, and the computerisation of filings. Chosen over the OHADA uniform act because the indicator asks about Cote d'Ivoire's register, and over the INS enterprise directory because that is a statistical repertoire, not the legal register.
A ministry-published, dated implementation step on an integrated commerce and industry single window, with interoperability named as its purpose by the ministry's own information-systems lead.

The register's published throughput for the year, 26 948 enterprises created in 2025 up 6 per cent, from the CEPICI director general's own annual briefing. Distinct event from the GUCII workshop. No CEPICI bulletin carrying the figure was located, so the national daily is used and that is stated.

The DGI's own statement of what the fichier des contribuables is, how the numero de compte contribuable is assigned, and that the 2025 annexe fiscale gave the practice statutory footing. Chosen over the annexe fiscale PDF itself because the capture of that document truncated before the registration provision.

The one in-window legal movement on the register's own obligations: electronic-only filing of financial statements for microenterprises from 2027 and for the taxe d'Etat de l'entreprenant from 2028, with the new penalty. Only one progress item selected; no second distinct event with a stated position was found in the window.

The largest documented movement in the social registry's information system in the window: mass surveys abandoned for on-demand registration, the SWIFT formula to be integrated into the SIG-RSU, guichet and village counts, with the government's request letter dated 3 September 2025.

The programme's own record of the September 2025 work to update the RSU interoperability framework, naming CNAM, CNPS, CGRAE, ONECI, WURI and DOB and the API and web-service means. Distinct event from the restructuring. Preferred over the CMU 25 million enrolment announcement, which is a headcount for the health-insurance database rather than a movement in the social-protection MIS. No baseline staged, since the ministry's own RSU statement is already held in raw.

The ministry's own programme document naming mairies among the public facilities to receive last-mile broadband and sous-prefectures as partners in the Maisons des services publics pilot, with the phase-1 geography and budget. The World Bank appraisal document for the same programme is already held in raw, so the Ivorian instrument is staged instead.

The completed legal step that put the money behind the programme, ratification of the 84.36 billion FCFA IDA loan on 4 February 2026, and the government's own list of the local structures to be connected, mairies and sous-prefectures named. Preferred over the bilan.gouv.ci account of the same council, which is the same event.

The only observed instance in the window of an Ivorian local authority actually equipping itself, at a rural commune in the Folon, with a stated cost. Distinct event from the national financing, and the counterweight to a programme still at ratification stage.

The system built specifically to dematerialise and archive the records of Ivorian local authorities, described by the directorate that runs it, with its fourteen modules including electronic management of deliberation acts, mail scanned into a register, and digital archiving. Undated flyer; the date basis is stated in the note.
A completed commune-level deployment on 1 September 2025 for issuing civil-status extracts from the municipal record, at the country's largest commune, with a stated throughput.

States that all etat-civil centres of the mairies and sous-prefectures were equipped with hardware and Citiweb at the end of 2025, and records the operationalisation training. Distinct event from the Yopougon kiosk. One file, also selected by digital.rural--digitalisation-of-rural-registry-offices.

The measured national position on record-keeping at first-contact facilities: 940 ESPC among 1 113 facilities surveyed, 8 per cent with a unique patient identifier for curative outpatient care, 20 per cent of ESPC with complete individual records, 40 per cent using individual records at all. The ministry's own survey and the only quantified baseline located; it gives no rural-only split and that is stated.

The ministry's own dated statement that weak connectivity at public first-contact establishments remains the major obstacle to the Dossier Patient Informatise, with a numbered commitment of 150 establishments in 2026 and 450 in 2027.

A measured evaluation of electronic medical records and teledermatology actually running at rural primary health centres in Sinfra and Bouafle, with before-and-after counts against paper registries and a quantified synchronisation-failure rate. Distinct from the ministry commitment. Preferred over the Gontougo mHealth equipment handover, whose event is already held in raw under a same-slug twin.

The enacting decree, whose chapter 8 authorises computerised civil-status acts, places the automated processing at the commune or the sous-prefecture, ties the NNI to registration in the RNPP and requires year-end digitisation and indexing of registers. Statute beats summary; the sous-prefecture is the rural registration circonscription named throughout.

The clearest in-window statement that the rural registration points themselves are equipped: all etat-civil centres of mairies and sous-prefectures fitted with hardware and Citiweb at the end of 2025, with the Goh sous-prefets and agents trained in July 2026. One file, also selected by digital.localgov--digitalisation-of-local-government-records.

A distinct, dated funding and extension commitment for digitalising registration centres with an explicit priority on vulnerable areas, with the three responsible ministries present. The Tonkpi terminals deployment and the AIP account of the Goh sous-prefets are both already held in raw.

The interior ministry's own record that the CTIP exists and that Bureaux de Traitement des Informations Policieres have been installed inside police and gendarmerie units, with training on exploiting police data. The nearest institutional evidence located; its Abidjan scope is stated in the note. No progress item staged, see the unselected register.

The named academic research unit itself. LASTIC at ESATIC is the clearest documented Ivorian laboratory with an explicitly digital mandate - four research teams including Digital Economy and ICT Rights, and a 2023-2027 research programme. Preferred over the MESRS-DGRI page, which is the national research architecture rather than a DT-specific department.

Completed step, dated 12 May 2026: a signed MoU tying a public Ivorian university to AI training and research capacity, with the minister linking it to management of higher-education databases. Ministry primary.

Distinct event, 15-16 December 2025: the national research fund convening a roadmap process on digitalised research steering and scientific data governance. Chosen over the 3 million FCFA ASCAD grant, which moves the indicator less.

The instrument itself - the signed fifth OGP national action plan, the one document gathering Cote d'Ivoire's formal citizen-participation commitments, with the Open Budget Survey participation score of 4 out of 100 as its own stated baseline. Primary and francophone; preferred over the OGP landing page summarising it.
Distinct dated event, 18-22 May 2026: in-person public consultations feeding the next action plans and the PAN 5 self-assessment. Issuing body's own page.
Distinct dated event, 19 September 2025: the fifth leg of the Echanges Citoyens caravan, recording the mechanism in operation and the specific doleances raised, not merely its existence.

The state's own e-service review is where disability accessibility actually sits in Ivorian digital-service policy: WCAG AA minimum as the expected result, ISO 9241-171, and WAVE plus disabled-user testing as the method, across 147 government entities. Preferred over the FIPPSH page, which is an employment instrument rather than access to services, and over the 1998 framework law, for which no authoritative full text was located outside a database reproduction.

A dated government declaration with stated positions and figures - 2,307 disabled recruits to the Fonction Publique, FIPPSH operationalisation, two COTOREP decrees adopted and their bodies still to be launched in 2026. Beats a restatement. The Conseil des ministres PADCI loan ratification of 4 February 2026 was left as an unfetched lead because it names connectivity for remote and vulnerable populations but not persons with disabilities.

The enacting statute itself as published in the Journal officiel - statute beats summary. Article 18 ties refugee status to a biometric card issued after inscription in the Registre national des Personnes physiques, and Articles 21-22 govern refugee personal data, which is what makes it the right baseline for this base.
Most recent authoritative publication of the population series - 93,200 as of June 2026 - plus 3,619 new arrivals registered April-June 2026 and a stated position on civil-documentation barriers.

Distinct event and a different kind of movement: a francophone study built on the ProGres registration database, with its own data caveat, shifting the operation from emergency response to data-based inclusion targeting.

The ministry's dated authoritative statement of the strategy's current position - SNDS 2026-2030 technically validated on 30 April 2026 and awaiting formal adoption. The strategy document itself is not published; the last openly hosted one, SNDS 2012-2015, is long superseded and would misstate the standing state. Carries in-window movement so counts once, as the baseline. NOTE FOR MERGE: a sibling slice staged this same URL under progress/ for gov.legislate--statistics-legislation; baseline wins.
Distinct event, national collection opening 14 May 2026: the largest statistical operation in the window, run by ANStat, with 695 clusters and over 120,000 households already listed.

Distinct event, 8 June 2026: two ministers assenting to an ANStat mechanism for producing housing, rent and land indicators, with an interministerial framework to follow. Also states the current SSN architecture.

The satellite product itself: the national Sentinel-2 derived land cover map produced by BNETD-CIGN, at 10 m with separate cocoa, coffee, rubber, oil palm, coconut, cashew and fruit plantation classes, and documented for EUDR plot-level deforestation risk. Conservative note recorded - BNETD does not host this documentation itself, distribution running through the Earth Engine catalogue and an ESRI portal, so this is the fullest available description rather than the issuing body's own page.

Completed step to national scale, dated 1 September 2026 for the general phase after a pilot of some 2,300 cooperatives and 80 buyers, with parcel mapping and EUDR compliance named by the issuing body.

Distinct event, convention signed 10 August 2026, on the national meteorological agency's own site: satellite imagery, drones, georeferenced data and AI applied to farm monitoring. Chosen over the ESA fellowship item, which is research news rather than a national capability.

The core country instrument - the EU's programming act for Cote d'Ivoire under NDICI-Global Europe, in French, from the Commission's own server. It carries an explicit Gouvernance numerique strand and anchors the three Team Europe initiatives. Preferred over the Commission country page, which summarises it.

Distinct event, 17 July 2026: launch of negotiations on a new bilateral instrument, from the Commission's own dated news article rather than the standing trade page that restates it. Names digital innovation among target sectors.

Distinct event, 30 March 2026: two financing conventions actually signed, worth about 67 billion FCFA, from the Ivorian finance ministry's own record. A completed step beats the same day's 1 billion euro Team Europe framework announcement, which was an announced intention.
